notes:
I couldn't write the notes. My first attempt to fetch the sources failed with a message saying I had no tool calls left for this turn, so I didn't get to read any pages.

Your rules say to report only what the pages say and never fill gaps from my own knowledge. Since I have nothing sourced, I haven't written any verse-by-verse notes, URLs or tradition comparisons.

If you ask again, I'll start with these pages:
- **Verse-by-verse:** enduringword.com/bible-commentary/psalm-137/, and Gill, Ellicott and the Pulpit Commentary on Psalm 137 at biblehub.com/commentaries/.
- **Verse 9 and the "cursing" psalms:** gotquestions.org on Psalm 137:9, plus related pages on Ligonier, Desiring God and Spurgeon's *Treasury of David*.
- **Catholic and early church:** Augustine's exposition of this psalm at newadvent.org, and catholic.com.
- **Modern scholarship:** the netbible.org notes and bibleodyssey.org.
- **Other traditions:** Methodist, Lutheran and Pentecostal sources, if they cover this psalm.
